test_objective: Verify receiving 503 – LdContextNotAvailable error if remote JSON-LD @context cannot be retrieved

test_cases.name: 043_01_01 Create entity
test_cases.doc: Verify receiving 503 – LdContextNotAvailable error if remote JSON-LD @context cannot be retrieved (Create entity)
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entities/'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload defined in file: 'building-unretrievable-context-sample.jsonld'
}

test_cases.name: 043_01_03 Create Temporal Representation of Entities
test_cases.doc: Verify receiving 503 – LdContextNotAvailable error if remote JSON-LD @context cannot be retrieved (Create Temporal Representation of Entities)
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/temporal/entities'
        method set to 'POST'
        Create or Update Temporal Representation of Entity Selecting Content Type: and
    Query Parameter: temporal_entity_representation_id set to '${temporal_entity_representation_id}' and
    Query Parameter: filename set to 'bus-temporal-representation-unretrievable-context-sample.jsonld' and
    Query Parameter: content_type set to 'application/ld+json' and
    Query Parameter: accept set to '${EMPTY}'
}

test_cases.name: 043_01_04 Batch entity create
test_cases.doc: Verify receiving 503 – LdContextNotAvailable error if remote JSON-LD @context cannot be retrieved (Batch entity create)
test_cases.when:
when {
    the SUT receives a Request from the client containing:
        URL set to '/ngsi-ld/v1/entityOperations/create'
        method set to 'POST'
        Request Header['Content-Type'] set to 'application/ld+json' and
 payload set to a list of entities to be created
}

 payload defined in file: '${updated_payload}'
